name: Mukto Mesh
description: Offline-first community hub for crisis coordination during internet shutdowns. Chat, safety check-ins, missing persons, emergency news — all on a local WiFi network with zero cloud dependency.

name: ContextForge
description: Research intelligence platform that ingests papers, code, and news, then builds a typed knowledge graph surfacing contradictions, gaps, and extensions that traditional lit reviews miss.

name: CareerPilot
description: AI-powered career platform with live job search, CV-to-vector fit scoring, a Kanban application tracker, and a RAG career coach grounded in your actual skills.

name: IUT Barakah Bites
description: Distributed microservices cafeteria ordering system with 5 Dockerized services, real-time SSE order tracking, a kitchen job queue, and chaos-tested resilience.

name: Lamina
description: Bilingual AI education assistant for Bangladeshi students with RAG over NCTB curriculum, an adaptive tutor, teacher copilot, and full offline PWA support.

name: PowerDesk
description: Real-time office device simulator with a live React dashboard, REST/WebSocket backend, and a Discord bot for instant power monitoring and alerts.

name: Ayatika
description: Desktop Quran study application written entirely in C. Full navigation across 114 Surahs, Vim-style controls, prayer times, bookmarks, fuzzy search, and an Azan screensaver.

name: Reading Into You
description: Psychological browser game in two modes: get profiled by an AI mentalist, or learn to read people yourself. 145 tests, WCAG 2.1 AA, typewriter aesthetic.

name: Notes Porbo
description: All-in-one study dashboard for IUT CSE course materials, organized by semester with daily-synced Drive extras via GitHub Actions.

name: Translucent Win11
description: Community guide to giving Windows 11 a glassmorphism makeover — system theming, app replacements, tiling WM setup, and browser customization.

name: qari-cli
description: Terminal scripture library packaged as a single static Rust binary: a three-column TUI reader with fourteen shelves (six revelations and eight hadith books), live fuzzy search, themes, bookmarks, and an offline-first disk cache.

name: Ship Cargo Loading System
description: Single-dock port cargo pipeline from Digital Logic Design lab: 4-bit cargo accumulation in a synchronous register, capacity-threshold comparison, tri-LED status, dual 7-seg dock display, and an auto-incrementing departure counter.

name: Purrcel
description: Landscape 2D endless runner about a courier cat: auto-run across a streamed procedural rooftop route, timed parcel deliveries, four unlockable districts, and an upgrades-and-breeds economy between runs. 184 EditMode and 32 PlayMode tests green.
